acceptance.item: P5-RT-08-05: T12 tells the reader on G2 that every representation of the board 'needs more than the game', which SPEC 2.18 and M8 beat 7 contradict
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/tools/T12.test.ts > regressions > P5-RT-08-05: T12 on G2 says every representation needs more than the game > G2 node 1 / G2 node 2: the sentence does not say that all its representations need more than the game
acceptance.evidence: Severity blocker (no adjustment). Red at base fcb02a5: 2 failed with the observed sentence. Cause: noMinusculeSentence stretched 2.18's [D] 'need more than the game' (which covers only representations out of reach of both recipes) to every representation of E8, F4 and G2. Now it reads 'This board has no minuscule node, so the recipe of this tool builds none of its representations.' No board-specific text. Green: 78 passed. Commit 803af94.

acceptance.item: P5-RT-09-01: T12's signed-move panel states the minuscule identities on every built node, where they are false (D4 node 2, the acceptance example) or their stated failure is false (B3 node 1)
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/tools/T12.test.ts > regressions > P5-RT-09-01: T12 states the identities of a minuscule orbit on every built node (3 tests: D4 node 2 k = 2; B3 node 1 k = 1; every node k of every built node of A3, B2, B3, C3, D4, D5, G2, F4)
acceptance.evidence: Severity blocker (no adjustment). Red at base: 3 failed. The D4 panel claimed both identities where the engine gives false; the B3 panel said 'no longer the move with signs' where both hold. Cause: the panel text did not depend on the state. Both identities, and the square (-1)^{H_k}, hold exactly when no number at node k in the orbit is 2 or more. largestAt decides this, and signedNote writes either the identities or why both fail. The reproducer could not be adopted unchanged: it asserted the claim and the engine's verdict together, so it fails whatever the panel says. Its inputs and engine computation are kept, and it asserts that each claim matches the engine. Green: 78 passed. Commits e12acac and c7eab40 (the second moves the text into signedNote with {@html} for size; text unchanged).

acceptance.item: P5-RT-09-02 and P5-RT-13-03 (DUPLICATE): T12's 'Dimension:' readout shows the size of the orbit on nodes that are not minuscule
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/tools/T12.test.ts > regressions > P5-RT-09-02 (7 cases '<board> node <n>: "Dimension:" against golden weyl_dimension', plus 'on every minuscule node the dimension is the orbit size and the golden dimension; Download data carries the dimension and the orbit size'); site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts > regressions > attack 9: T12 on E8/F4/G2/D4 ... does not print "Dimension: <orbit>"
acceptance.evidence: Severity major (no adjustment). Red at base: unit 8 failed (24/28, 6/7, 24/26, 240/248, 6/7, 2160/3875, 24/52); e2e on a base build 4 failed (240, 24, 6, 24). Cause: dimensionOf (the basis size) was shown and exported as 'Dimension'. 'Dimension' now shows representationDimension (the engine's weylDimension of the fundamental position) on every node. The orbit's size, which is the size of the matrices, is labelled 'Positions in the orbit' (new data-out orbit-size). Download data 'dimension' is the representation's dimension. Both reproducers pass unchanged. Tests that read the orbit size under 'dimension' now read 'orbit-size' (T12.spec.ts x5, T12.test.ts x1, M8.spec.ts x1). Green: unit 78 passed, T12.spec.ts 47 passed. Commit e69b582. The two senses of 'dimension' are left to the owner; options are in the fragment.

handoff: Every changed file is in T12 or in its tests (M8.spec.ts only for the hooks and e_i, plus the new omega check); nothing under site/src/content/modules/ was touched. onPopState, readLink and admitLink were not edited. One request is in the fragment: the JSDoc of admitLink still says 'the start omega_k' and should say 'the start all ones of SPEC 6.6'. Dimension: the coordinator's 'keep Dimension only where it is the representation's dimension' is met by always showing weylDimension under 'Dimension' and the orbit count under 'Positions in the orbit'. This lets both reproducers pass unchanged. The finding's proposedFix (Dimension on minuscule nodes only) is the owner's option (b) in the fragment. Its cost on /tools/rep/ is a few bytes, because weylDimension was already in the shared engine chunk. Size is now 89830 B of 90000; any later T12 change has about 170 B. The timing test 'no long task when E6/E7 is picked' (4x slowdown) is marginal in this shared container. At load 8 to 10 the branch had 3 long tasks of 53 to 56 ms (including both earlier full-file runs); at load 3 it passed 12/12 and the final full file passed 47/47. The base passed 14/14 isolated runs and one full-file run. The extra work per pick (string viewer from all ones, weylDimension) is about 0.1 to 0.25 ms in Node. MERGE and GATE should rerun these two tests alone on a quiet machine. For the lens rerun: M8's b3, b5 to b7 and b10 to b12 give no start, so their string viewers now start at all ones. The other RT-03 bounds test (not in this cluster) still expects the old ω3 limit sentence and needs 'e3'.
